text:
Shinjuku Station has 7 places within six minutes of its exits that cover every hour of the day: soba from 6:20, tsukemen at lunch, a curry first served in 1927, and ramen that never closes 👇

🎯 Guess which exit has ramen 30 seconds from the gate, then check 👉 https://japanbystation.com/food-near-shinjuku-station

We checked every opening time, price and closing day against the shops' own listings, and only kept places rated 4★+ on Google Maps when we looked.

🍜 BREAKFAST

Kameya, West Exit, 2 min: soba with tempura and egg for about ¥600, from 6:20. Closed Sundays, cash only, eight seats.

Sawamura in NEWoMan by the New South Exit: a calm bakery breakfast from 7:00, every day.

🥢 LUNCH

Fuunji, South Exit, 6 min: tsukemen ¥1,000. Fifteen counter seats, and it closes when the soup runs out, so go at 11:00.

🍛 DINNER

Manna at Nakamuraya, East Exit: the Indian-style curry has been on the menu since 1927. No reservations; you queue like everyone else.

🌙 AFTER MIDNIGHT

Nagi in Golden Gai: dried-sardine ramen, ten seats up a steep staircase, open 24 hours.

💴 Carry cash: three of the seven take no cards.

👉 The curry that hid a revolutionary, plus all 7 picks by exit:
